SARR(UHES) WACHTELHASHR Bioku63 1073Y 110ES9 7t S7 20-19B0A94 Bwolll43 ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT ATU: A/ PD SWE2( ofw _,2000, by and between GARY STRUTIN,having an address at 115 Cedar Street,NewRochelle,NewYork,(hereinafterreferred toas"Owner")andBROADWAY2 ASSOCIATES, having an address at 736 Bryant Street, Woodmere, New York (hereinafter referred to as"Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is the owner infeetitleofa certain parcel of land,with thebuildings and improvements thereon,in the City, County and State of NewYork,known as and by the street address 2067 Broadway and the tax lot Block 1163, Lot 32 and more particularly described in Exhibit A- .annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (said land and tax lots being hereinafter referred to as"Owner's Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as"Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Property"); WHEREAS,Developer is the owner of fee title of a certain parcel of land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City, County and State of New York, known as and by the street addresses 2069-2079 Broadway and the tax lot Block1163,Lot 33 and more particularly described in Exhibit A- annexed hereto and made a part thereof (said land and tax lots being referred to herein as "Developer's Land"; and said land and buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as "Developer's Property"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct a new building upon all or a portion of Developer's Land (said new building, with any further additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being herein called the "New Building"; Owner's Land and Developer's Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the "Parcels" and each individually as a "Parcel"); WHEREAS,it is contemplated that theNewBuildingwill contain more floor area (herein referred to as "Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961 (the "Zoning Resolution") than is now available for use under the "floor area ratio" limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution related to Developer's Land as an independent "zoning lot", with the result that Developer desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolutionfor combiningDeveloper's Land and Owner's Land into a single "zoning lot" for the purpose of determining compliance by the New Buildingwith such limitation; WHEREAS,there exist Floor Area Development Rights (hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to Owner's Land which are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by Owner'sBuilding and thesame are availablefor transferpursuant totheZoningResolution.

As used in this Agreement, the term"Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to developsuchzoninglotby erecting thereon a structure orstructureswitha totalfloor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of such zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which such zoning lot is located, and (ii) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of NewYork (the"City"); WHEREAS, in order to construct the New Building with the excess bulk on Developer's Land, Developer acquired the Available Development Rights from Owner's Land pursuant to that certain Zoning Lot Merger Option Agreement between Developer and Owner dated as of June 1, 2000 (the"Effective Date").As used in this Agreement,"Available Development Rights" shall mean (i) the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to Owner's Land as of the Effective Date including any and all development rights resulting from any upward revision after theEffectiveDatebytheCityoftheallowablefloor arearatioandany andall development rights and other benefits which may become available to Purchaser or Seller through any law or regulation allowing purchase of development rights or other benefits from properties which are not included in the Single Zoning Lot less (ii) the amount of Retained Development Rights (as hereinafter defined), which Available Development Rights constitute 8,994 square feet. Owner has agreed to permit Developer to utilize Owner's Available Development Rights, on the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth,it being understood and agreed,however,that Owner is retaining for its own benefit Floor Area Development Rights permitting development of 20,985 square feet of Floor Area (as defined in the Zoning Resolution) and all other rights ancillary thereto pertaining to Owner's Property as same exists as of the Effective Date including any floor area and development rights resulting from any upward revisions before the Effective Date by the City of the allowable floor area ratio (such Floor Area Development Rights and other rights being referred to herein as the "Retained Development Rights"); NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties heretoagree asfollows: ARTICLEI DECLARATIONOFRESTRICTIONS Section 1.1. The parties hereto are, simultaneously herewith, executing and delivering a Declaration of Restrictions, as defined in Section 12-1 0 of the Zoning Resolution (herein called the "Declaration"), a copy of which Declaration is annexed hereto as Exhibit B and made a part hereof, which seeks to effectuate the intentions of the parties set forth in the preamble to this both Owner's Land and Developer's Land, Friedman, Alfred\72d &BroadwayZLDA #2 2
